notes.title: THE TRUTH ABOUT PRAY AND SPRAY
notes.notes:
It seems as though people are still downloading the game... and you may wonder what's with the lack of content...

The truth and the matter is, I have broken the hard drive in which the game was stored. I have nothing left of pray and spray. 

I wish I could update the game and make it better but I physically cannot. They want to charge me 2,000+ USD to fix and restore the hard drives data. 

Me, being a solo indie dev, I do not make much money. I dream of fixing it always. Not only pray and spray but I also lost other projects I spent years creating. 

It's a shameful situation all around. I have learned lessons. I hope that one day I can restore the drive and bring you amazing updates. 

Thanks for listening! 

Stay tuned to my upcoming game DEFRACTED. Which will have pray and spray mechanics x10 and more.

All players must make an account in order to play its quick and simple. Everyone's going to start fresh
and at level 1. Sorry for any inconvenience. Not like there was much to lose to begin with! This was a feature that was on Pray And Spray before but due to a major bug I had to take it down. But its surely up and running again and bug free! 

Also because of the new level feature, people who owned the game before might have weapons in they're classes that are not unlocked. That's because your saved data is the same. To remain bug free I suggest people change there weapons in the class customize section to they're rightful ones, if not, you might experience bugs customizing weapons.
